original_test_intent: Preserve independent E1S_BD1 I2C coverage while refusing to guess whether the board is validated through BMC-side logical reachability, physical connector/continuity work, or separately accepted stages.
original_method: No method is authorized until Engineering supplies the BD1 board/slot/connector identity and states the required operation, topology, safe power/ESD state and acceptance. The classification must be reconsidered in a fresh review after that decision.
manual_activity: E1.S/platform owners must define BD1's exact hardware identity and decide whether the mandatory evidence is logical I2C, physical/continuity, or both before execution mode can be classified.
required_inputs: Board, slot, cable and connector identifiers
Decision on logical, physical and/or continuity checkpoints
If physical: pinout, isolation/ESD and measurement limits
safety_requirements: Do not infer physical continuity from the item name
Do not copy BD2 steps or topology
Do not probe unknown pins or I2C addresses
Do not energize an incomplete or miswired connection
Do not treat logical enumeration as proof of every conductor
Preserve E1.S/NVMe, BMC and connector evidence
Stop on damage, open/short, storage, management or bus anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Perform no I2C or physical action
Keep BD1 evidence independent from BD2
Require fresh review after owner ruling

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek supplies no command and correctly refuses execution, but describes physical continuity without source support. Until the spec chooses the test modality, neither a BMC probe nor a manual continuity procedure can be judged applicable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: BLOCKED: resolve E1S_BD1 identity and logical-versus-physical test semantics before selecting a command or manual procedure.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: E1S_BD1 and its two-minute estimates are preserved; no bus, address, connector, pin or continuity limit is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: PENDING E1S_BD1 SCOPE AND METHOD DECISION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After ruling, bind logical checks to the exact BMC/OOB route and expected endpoint responses, and bind any physical/continuity stage to named connectors, pins, isolation state and measurement limits; keep their evidence separate.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Avoids silently converting an unspecified I2C board case into an exclusively manual continuity test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Logical reachability cannot prove all conductors or mechanical integrity, while continuity/inspection cannot prove protocol enumeration and managed-device behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Physical work can damage an E1.S connector or storage path; unknown I2C probing can disturb sideband devices. The final MANUAL/REQUIRES/BLOCKED outcome depends on the approved scope.

project_override_considerations: Apply BMC/platform ownership to any I2C stage, while separately governing physical BD1 handling; require board/slot/connector identity and exact expected evidence for each stage.
expected_evidence: Approved E1S_BD1 specification and fresh review
If logical: BMC controller/mux/address and complete expected-response evidence
If physical: photos, pin/continuity measurements and safe-state records
Pre/post E1.S/NVMe presence/health plus BMC SEL/SDR/OS evidence
Recovery audit and owner verdict per checkpoint

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master contains only placeholders, so there is no internal contradiction; the conflict is between unsupported reference interpretations and missing authoritative semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core operation modality is unknown. Classifying the case as manual or choosing a BMC probe would each invent different coverage, safety conditions and evidence.

engineering_decision_request.question: Define Functionality row 1810 Wistron-HW-00432-V002 E1S_BD1: exact board/slot/cable/connector identity and whether required coverage is BMC/OOB logical I2C reachability, physical inspection/continuity, or separately accepted stages; provide bus/mux/address/responses and/or pinout/isolation/measurement limits, storage-health criteria, aborts and recovery while preserving Master and requiring fresh review.

review_improvement: Corrects the unsupported assumption that missing E1.S board-level steps necessarily make the case MANUAL ONLY, preserving the unresolved logical-versus-physical distinction.
independent_technical_reasoning: The I2C test set and item name establish a board target but not an operation. A board-level case could validate sideband enumeration, harness continuity or both. Those alternatives require different tools, owners and PASS criteria; therefore the review cannot safely classify or execute the case until the external specification resolves the modality.
